title: Roasted Brussels with Balsamic Glaze
description: Sheet-pan roasted Brussels sprouts tossed in a reduced balsamic and garlic glaze. Simple weeknight side that caramelizes well in a hot oven.

ingredients.note: source says 'a little olive oil spray' during roasting

steps.title: Toss Brussels
steps.text: In a large bowl, toss {i01} with {i02}, {i03}, {i04}, and {i05} until evenly coated.

steps.title: Arrange on pan
steps.text: Line a sheet pan with foil and spread the Brussels in a single layer.

steps.title: Roast, tossing every 15 min
steps.text: Roast at 400°F for 30–35 minutes total. Check at 15 minutes, toss, and hit them with {i06}. Repeat every few minutes after that, tossing and spraying each time so they don't dry out and burn.

steps.title: Make the glaze
steps.text: While the Brussels roast, combine {i07}, {i08}, and {i09} in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then lower to a low simmer. Stir frequently so it doesn't burn. Reduce for about 20 minutes, until reduced by a little more than half. Taste to make sure the sharp vinegary bite has cooked off.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.text: When the Brussels are done roasting, toss them with the balsamic glaze and serve immediately.

rawText:
Roasted Brussels with Balsamic Glaze

	⁃	Bag of halved Brussels
	⁃	Couple glugs of olive oil
	⁃	Maybe 1/4 ish tsp each of salt and pepper
	⁃	Couple chopped garlic cloves

Toss all of that in a bowl. Put on a sheet pan with foil. 400 for 30-35 min total. Check at 15 min and then a few more times after that. Each time toss them and give them a little olive oil spray so they don’t dry out and burn and keep roasting.   Glaze
	⁃	Cup of balsamic vinegar
	⁃	Couple crushed garlic cloves
	⁃	Pinch of crushed red pepper

Bring to a boil then lower to a low simmer for maybe 20ish min. Stir so it doesn’t burn. Done when it’s reduced by a little more than half. Taste to make sure the vinegary taste cooks off.

Toss all that shit together when the Brussels are done.
